s2.ptxt: Make sure that the ignition switch is OFF.
Check that the battery negative terminal is disconnected.

item.ptxt: If work is performed without disconnecting the negative battery terminal, the airbag may deploy even if only the airbag computer assembly itself receives an impact, so be sure to check that the cable is disconnected from the negative battery terminal before performing the work.
After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Install the airbag computer assembly with the 3 bolts.

item.ptxt: Do not reuse any part that has been dropped or subjected to a strong impact during work.
When turning the IG ON for the first time after replacing the airbag computer assembly, make sure there is no one in the vehicle.
Check that there is no looseness in the airbag computer assembly.

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector to the airbag computer assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the drip-proof sheet is not turned up or pinched.
